product_offering.core_offering: Baseten provides an AI inference platform that enables businesses to deploy, optimize, and scale open-source, custom, and fine-tuned AI models in production. The Baseten Inference Stack combines custom model runtimes, custom kernels, advanced caching, the latest decoding techniques, and multi-cloud capacity management across 18-20 cloud providers and 87 clusters globally. Offerings include Dedicated Deployments for custom models, pre-optimized Model APIs, Training infrastructure, and the Frontier Gateway for white-label inference APIs, supported by Forward Deployed Engineers for hands-on customer support.
product_offering.differentiator: 1) Most performant inference at scale via the Baseten Inference Stack with custom kernels, custom runtimes, advanced caching, and the latest decoding techniques — validated by independent benchmarks (NVIDIA-cited 4-10x cost reductions on Blackwell). 2) Multi-cloud, multi-region capacity across ~18-20 cloud providers and 87 clusters, enabling scale-from-zero autoscaling with 99.999% uptime. 3) End-to-end platform combining dedicated deployments, Model APIs, Training, Embeddings Inference, and Frontier Gateway under one roof. 4) Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embedded with strategic customers, enabling companies without ML teams to deploy production AI. 5) Open-source model specialization rather than building base models — serves the open-weight ecosystem with optimized open-source alternatives to closed APIs. 6) Own your intelligence thesis: helps companies build systems shaped by proprietary data, evals, domain-specific harnesses, post-training, and custom RL environments rather than renting from closed providers.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Fastest model runtimes, cross-cloud high availability, seamless developer workflows, fast cold starts (5-10 seconds), low latency (sub-250ms p90), high reliability (99.999% uptime), major cost reductions (4-10x vs proprietary alternatives, 65%+ vs competitors), ability to own proprietary data and models, post-training research support.
product_offering.problem_solved: Inference has become the critical bottleneck for AI deployment as the industry shifts from model training to production deployment. Baseten solves the gap between frontier model availability and production-ready inference — providing the fastest model runtimes, cross-cloud high availability, fine-tuning, embeddings, transcription, image generation, and managed gateways on a single platform, enabling companies to deploy open-source and custom models at scale with predictable cost, latency, and reliability.

product_offering.product_overview: Baseten offers a unified AI inference platform with a platform-plus-modules architecture centered on the Baseten Inference Stack, which combines the fastest model runtimes, cross-cloud high availability, and seamless developer workflows. The platform encompasses core products Dedicated Inference (for high-scale workloads serving open-source, custom, and fine-tuned models), Model APIs (pre-optimized model endpoints with pay-per-token pricing), Training (for owning model weights with one-click deployment), and Frontier Gateway (managed gateway for AI model labs to deploy white-labeled production inference APIs), supported by deployment options (Baseten Cloud, Self-hosted, and Hybrid), platform modules including Multi-cloud Capacity Management (MCM), Baseten Chains for compound AI, and Baseten Embeddings Inference (BEI), plus the open-source Truss framework and the acquired Parsed post-training capabilities. Together these offerings let customers deploy, optimize, and manage AI models with exceptional latency, reliability, observability, and cost at production scale across more than 15 cloud providers.

profiles.name: Tuhin Srivastava
profiles.overview: Co-founder and CEO of Baseten, leading the AI inference infrastructure company's strategic direction and growth since co-founding the firm in 2019.
profiles.profile_commentary: Tuhin Srivastava co-founded Baseten in 2019 alongside Amir Haghighat, Philip Howes, and Pankaj Gupta and has served as CEO since inception. Under his leadership, Baseten scaled from a $20M seed/Series A round in 2022 to a $1.5B Series F at a $13B valuation by June 2026, growing revenue approximately 20x year-over-year to an annualized run-rate approaching $1 billion in 2026. He is the public voice of the company, frequently quoted in major outlets (WSJ, Forbes, Reuters, VentureBeat, TechCrunch) and appearing on industry podcasts such as the AI Compute podcast to discuss inference as the bottleneck in AI deployment. He has guided the company through the December 2025 acquisition of Parsed (a reinforcement learning startup) and the strategic $150M investment from NVIDIA in January 2026, positioning Baseten as the partner of choice for AI-native companies shipping production AI products.

recent_move.description: Closed a $1.5B Series F at up to $13B valuation across two tranches ($11B and $13B), the fourth fundraise in 18 months, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction, Spark Capital with Sands Capital and Wellington Management as co-leads.
Closed a $300M Series E at $5B valuation led by IVP and CapitalG, including a $150M strategic investment from NVIDIA — anchoring Baseten within the dominant GPU supplier's ecosystem.

Acquired Parsed, a reinforcement learning startup specializing in post-training and continual learning for large models, bringing Oxford-educated researchers in-house to unify inference, data, evaluation, and post-training on a single platform.

Launched Frontier Gateway, a managed white-label gateway enabling AI model labs (e.g., Poolside) to deploy production-grade inference APIs with authentication, rate limiting, billing integration, and lab-branded URLs.
Launched the Baseten Training platform, expanding beyond inference into on-demand training infrastructure (L4, A10G, A100, H100, B200) for SFT and RL workflows with one-click deployment to inference.
Committed to tripling headcount from 147 employees in 2025 to support talent acquisition, compute infrastructure buildout, and enterprise go-to-market expansion.

expansion_highlight.description: Series F of $1.5B in June 2026 explicitly earmarked for aggressive investment in compute, software, and talent; revenue projected to clear $1B in 2026 per CEO commentary, indicating capital is being deployed to scale capacity ahead of demand rather than fund losses.
Headcount plan to triple from 147 in 2025 to roughly 440+ in 2026, with stated focus on enterprise GTM and talent acquisition; signals aggressive sales and engineering build-out.

Parsed acquisition (Dec 2025) added RL/post-training capabilities, extending the platform vertically from inference-only into training, evaluation, and continual learning on real production data — a meaningful TAM expansion.

Frontier Gateway (May 2026) opens a new channel serving AI model labs as OEM customers, with Poolside cited as a launch customer; this diversifies revenue away from direct AI-application customers toward monetizing third-party frontier models.

Baseten Training launch (Dec 2025) and Baseten Chains framework (June 2024) extend the product surface from single-model inference into compound AI workflows and custom model ownership, targeting enterprises that want to own their weights.

Google Cloud Marketplace listing (Sept 2024) plus self-hosted and hybrid deployment options open enterprise procurement channels and enable leverage of existing cloud commitments, materially expanding addressable enterprise buyers.

SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance plus healthcare-vertical customer concentration (OpenEvidence, Abridge, Ambience Healthcare, Sully.ai, Picnic Health, Latent Health) signal deliberate penetration of regulated verticals where compliance is a prerequisite.
